topics: Abbreviations, URL, Binary system (binary to decimal, radix point, patterns), Boolean & logic operators, Memory storage, CPU architecture, Networking (PAN, WAN, IMAP), Data transfer, MPEG, Floating point notation
reviews.review: Paper zyada tar handouts se tha. Abbreviations, binary system, Boolean/logic operators, memory storage aur basic networking se questions aaye. Overall paper easy tha aur jo students ne handouts ache se parhe thay un ke liye simple tha. Questions were mostly theoretical and concept-based from handouts.
